body:
After having some foot surgery I was prescribed 30 pills of Hydrocodone/Aceta 7.5/750.  I'm a pretty frequent Cannibus smoker, but have had minimal experience with Narcotics.  I used the Cold Water Extraction Technique on three crushed pills.  I don't know how well the process went, and probably need to practice it.  I drink the solution with some Hawaiian Punch mix, and it is still awful.
t - 0.15 I'm feeling slightly body tingling, I am zoning out easily.
t -  .30 My ass is quite tingly, I enjoy it.  I also crave edamame and salt.
t -  .45 When I stand to get the salt, I realize I am dizzy and stumbly, but content.  I eat the edamame quickly.
I don't feel the effects so strongly, so I pack a bowl of Cannibus and take two hits.  This stuff as recently proven to be of monster quality.  That was at t - 1 h.
The Cannibus is doing is having it's usual headiness (which I like), but it is now combined with an INTENSE body high from the hydrocodone.  I'm shivering, having orgasmic contractions, and can close my eyes and be wiggling my toes with the greatest sensations, with a big grin.  This is awesome.  We are now t1hr19 mins in.  I am going to sit and listen to music, or masturbate, or both.
